profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to tackle automation challenges and to change what people expect robots to do. Its site highlights Stretch, a robot it says is easy to deploy and flexible, aimed at streamlining case handling and warehouse automation. The company also publishes white papers and eBooks about the development, implementation, and value of robots and automation solutions.

The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, in the United States. It operates as a for-profit public company. No litigation cases involving the company are listed, and its legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts with a count of 176.
